appearances.whereabouts: In the library of The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn
appearances.notable_actions: Explains the history and nature of the Ways at length; describes the Time of Madness, the Ogier Exile, and the gift of the Ways by male Aes Sedai; warns of the dangers (Machin Shin, the Black Wind); reluctantly agrees to guide the group through the Ways to reach the Eye of the World despite the edict of the Elders
appearances.demeanor: Initially uncomfortable and apologetic about his outburst; hesitant and worried about breaking the edict; eventually resigned to his duty

appearances.whereabouts: In the library of The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn; later checking on Rand and Mat before dawn
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the planning session for the journey to the Eye of the World; explains the stakes (the Dark One potentially using the Eye's power); persuades everyone of the necessity; tells them they are part of the Pattern and have a choice but the Pattern will use them regardless; heals Rand's wound at the end of the chapter
appearances.demeanor: Commanding, authoritative, patient in explanation; her presence described as throne-like when making her crucial speech; calm and deliberate

appearances.whereabouts: In the library planning session at The Queen's Blessing; later in his shared room under the eaves; in the dream confrontation with Ba'alzamon
appearances.notable_actions: Agrees to go to the Eye of the World; paces nervously during planning; tries to convince Egwene to leave for safety; has a dream encounter with Ba'alzamon where he sees three clay figures and destroys them; gets a splinter in his hand that vanishes after he removes it; wakes and washes the wound repeatedly; has Moiraine heal the wound
appearances.demeanor: Anxious, restless, protective of Egwene; terrified during and after the dream; desperate to deny Ba'alzamon

appearances.whereabouts: In the library planning session; later in the shared room under the eaves; in the dream with Ba'alzamon
appearances.notable_actions: Agrees to go to the Eye of the World; questions why they are so important; has the same dream as Rand, seeing three figures and picking up the one with the dagger that had his face; keeps the dagger from Shadar Logoth under his pillow; tries to sound like his old self when joking about his family
appearances.demeanor: Worried, fearful, sitting with clenched hands; later terrified after the dream; clutching the dagger for comfort

appearances.whereabouts: In the library planning session at The Queen's Blessing
appearances.notable_actions: Agrees to go to the Eye of the World; shows a brief, disturbing flash of eagerness when mentioning hunting along the Blight, then immediately shudders at his own words
appearances.demeanor: Resigned, weary, as if he has fought something until he can no longer fight and is waiting for it to finish him; briefly his yellow eyes flash with an alien eagerness

appearances.whereabouts: In the library planning session at The Queen's Blessing
appearances.notable_actions: Defies any suggestion that she stay behind; insists she is part of the Pattern according to what Min saw; listens to the planning intently; speaks privately with Rand; becomes angry when Rand mentions Elayne, thinking he is not being serious
appearances.demeanor: Defiant, determined, softening briefly when thanking Rand for his concern, then angry when he mentions Elayne

appearances.whereabouts: In the library planning session at The Queen's Blessing
appearances.notable_actions: Initially protests going into the Ways, calling the plan mad; agrees to accompany the group; creates a detailed supply list with steady handwriting; challenges Moiraine about her need for Nynaeve's herbs
appearances.demeanor: Angry at first, then resigned but determined; muttering under her breath while working; matter-of-fact and practical

appearances.whereabouts: Joins the planning session in the library after dark
appearances.notable_actions: Contributes to the planning with comments in his characteristic drawl; glances occasionally at Mat's dagger; opens the door for Master Gill each time the innkeeper enters

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn, entering the library several times
appearances.notable_actions: Lights the lamps; brings food personally; reports on events outside (Whitecloaks watching, riot at Inner City gates, someone trying to mark the Dragon's Fang on the door); takes the supply list and payment from Moiraine; promises to wake them before dawn and says they will leave the watchers 'watching an empty box'
appearances.demeanor: Helpful, discreet, respectful; does not pry into their plans despite his curiosity; knocks and waits even though it is his own inn

appearances.whereabouts: In the dream chamber with Rand
appearances.notable_actions: Confronts Rand in a dream; shows him three clay figures representing Rand, Mat, and Perrin; claims the contest between them has happened countless times across ages; offers Rand power and dominion if he will kneel and serve; reveals the existence of the Black Ajah; laughs mockingly when Rand denies him; the echo of 'die' overwhelms Rand
appearances.demeanor: Mocking, commanding, supremely confident; eyes and mouth become caverns of flame when he speaks; laughs in rich, rolling peals
